interpretation: Household shock precedes sustained family-mora rise, but profitability moves early and provisioning ratio does not show a delayed upward response.
Mora trend clearly predates household t0; later provisioning response is compatible with credit stress but not with a clean household→mora onset.
Provisions respond immediately and ROA falls before material mora acceleration; observed bank adjustments cannot be treated as reactions to mora alone.
No same immediate household wage shock, so the domestic sequence is not universal.
